en.name: Mouth of Sauron
en.ability: Each night, choose a character: they are poisoned until dusk, then evil secretly communicates for 1 minute.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose a character: they are poisoned until dusk, then evil secretly communicates for 1 minute.

en.flavor: The rider was robed all in black, and black was his lofty helm...and his name is remembered in no tale; for he himself had forgotten it, and he said: ‘I am the Mouth of Sauron.'
en.firstNightReminder: The Mouth chooses a character, then evil communicates.
en.otherNightReminder: The Mouth chooses a character, then evil communicates.
